title: 菊花賞の後に・生来の強運

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright manages to beat Matikanefukukitaru and wins the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has proven that she can run long-distance races as well as medium. However, this also means we now have to decide on which category to focus on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide Mejiro Bright should compete in the Stayers Stakes as another test of her potential as a stayer.
